role: Chairman and Chief Technology Officer of Oracle
promise: Oracle will spend about $50 billion in capital expenditure in fiscal 2026 to expand AI cloud infrastructure
description: Oracle raised its fiscal 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $50 billion as it expanded capacity for large AI cloud customers, and separately expected to raise $45 billion to $50 billion in debt and equity during the year.
